text:
𝗕𝗔𝗡 𝟴𝟱/𝟲 𝗔𝗧 𝗧𝗘𝗔! 🌧️

After a 3h45m rain delay, Jansen and Nortje took 2 each at Centurion.

Can Bangladesh recover? 👇
#SAvBAN #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗕𝗔𝗡𝗚𝗟𝗔𝗗𝗘𝗦𝗛 𝟴𝟱/𝟲 𝗣𝗘 𝗟𝗟𝗔𝗗𝗔𝗞𝗛𝗔𝗗𝗔𝗔𝗬𝗔! 😳🏏

👉 Centurion Test mein barish ke 3h45m delay ke baad SA ne pehle bowling li
👉 Tea tak Bangladesh 85/6 (27 ov)
👉 Jansen aur Nortje ne 2-2 wicket liye
👉 Bangladesh ne 23 saal baad pehli baar 4 pacers ke saath khela

Kya Bangladesh wapsi kar payega? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #SAvBAN #Cricket
